name: Littlestone Dimension of Majority
details: The class contains every labeling of its n ordinary coordinates, with the final coordinate determined by strict majority.
proof: Query the n ordinary coordinates in a fixed order. Every binary sequence of answers is realized by the concept whose ordinary-coordinate subset is that sequence, so this is a shattered tree of depth n. Conversely, a class of size $2^n$ cannot shatter a complete binary tree of depth greater than n: distinct leaves require distinct realizing concepts. Hence the Littlestone dimension is exactly n.
